retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour 1980s portrait style featuring a central subject in vibrant red satin against a dark background, accented by diagonal graphic patterns and mixed serif/script typography.
triggerTerms: glamour portrait with diagonal graphic accents
red satin studio photography with soft focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair wearing a red satin blouse, positioned against a split background of black and a soft-focus floral/branch motif. The composition is framed by a top-aligned graphic element consisting of pink and white diagonal stripes and layered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in vibrant red dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
Typography is layered over a geometric striped banner at the top.
High contrast between the subject's red clothing and the deep black background.
Soft, diffused lighting creates a glow on the skin and satin texture.
coreInvariants: Mixed display serif and casual script typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject centered horizontally, leaning on one hand, filling the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright red satin blouse.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left typography, moves across the name, down to the script title, and settles on the subject's face and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space behind the subject's shoulders provides high contrast.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red channel against low-value dark backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses italicized, high-contrast serifs with thin hairlines.
Secondary text uses a fluid, monolinear script that mimics hand-drawn marker strokes.
Text is often outlined or layered over graphic shapes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast formal serif paired with informal, airy script.
graphicDevices: Underlining script with multiple parallel lines

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant serif structure.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn 80s marker aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with large 80s hair in a red satin blouse, leaning on her hand against a black background with soft-focus white flowers in the upper corners. Leave the top third clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular banner of pink and white diagonal stripes at the top. Overlay large red italic serif text with a white outline. Below it, add a red monoline script title with a triple-line underline.

verificationChecks: Is the red satin vibrant and textured?
Are the diagonal stripes present behind the main text?
Is the script text thin and fluid?
Is the lighting soft and glamorous?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the diagonal stripe banner.
Ensure the red blouse is the primary color focus.
Check that the script text has a hand-drawn quality.
Confirm the background is predominantly dark/black.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Glamour Portrait + Red Satin + Diagonal Stripe Banner + Mixed Serif/Script Typography
